MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_HOWLING_BLADE.de:
If the target has {BurstAt} or more [gold]Scars[/gold], they burst right now instead of waiting for 12.
Otherwise, apply {Wounds} Scars.
[gold]Sköfnung[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (bursts at 6 Scars from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_WRAITH_SHROUD.de:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain extra Block equal to half (rounded down) of the [gold]Scars[/gold] on ALL enemies combined.
[gold]Sköfnung[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level).
Whenever a [gold]Scar[/gold] bursts, apply {Chain} Scars to every other enemy.
Whenever an enemy with Scars dies, its Scars move to a random other enemy.
[gold]Sköfnung[/gold] level {SwordLevel}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_HARD_EDGE.title: Hard Edge
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_HARD_EDGE.descri:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Until your next turn, while [gold]Durandal[/gold] is your current sword, its attack damage reduction is {Bonus} higher.
Each time that reduction brings an attack to 0 damage, draw 1 more card next turn (max {MaxDraws}).
[gold]Durandal[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level).
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Deals {PerHit} more damage for each enemy attack hit [gold]Durandal[/gold] reduced since your last turn ended.
[gold]Durandal[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).
This combat, whenever an enemy attack hits you while [gold]Durandal[/gold] is your current sword, deal damage equal to Durandal's damage reduction to that enemy.
[gold]Durandal[/gold] level {SwordLevel}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_ROLANDS_END.desc:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
This combat, you can switch to [gold]Durandal[/gold] even at 30% HP or less.
While your HP is at or below 30%, Durandal's attack damage reduction is {Bonus} higher.
[gold]Durandal[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DAINSLEIF_BLADE_RETURNS.d:
Look at the top {Look} cards of your draw pile. Put 1 of them into your hand.
[gold]Dáinsleif[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (top 4 from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DAINSLEIF_BLADE_RETURNS.s: Choose a card to put into your hand.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DAINSLEIF_RISEN_SLAIN.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the top card of your draw pile is an Attack, play it for free (random target).
[gold]Dáinsleif[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DAINSLEIF_SHIELD_CAST_ASI:
Whenever a card would give you [gold]Block[/gold] but can't because [gold]Dáinsleif[/gold] is your current sword, deal {HitDamage} damage to a random enemy instead.
[gold]Dáinsleif[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TYRFING_SHIELD_SPLITTER.d:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Then the target loses ALL its [gold]Block[/gold], and you gain half of it (rounded down).
[gold]Tyrfing[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+2 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TYRFING_LIFE_PRICE.title: Life-Price
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TYRFING_LIFE_PRICE.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Fatal[/gold]: If this kills an enemy, Exhaust a random Curse card from your hand, draw pile or discard pile.
[gold]Tyrfing[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TYRFING_HERVORS_DEMAND.de:
Gain 1 [gold]Energy[/gold] for each Curse card in your hand (max {MaxEnergy}).
Draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
[gold]Tyrfing[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (max 3 from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SOLAIS_RADIANCE.title: Radiance
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SOLAIS_RADIANCE.descripti:
Double your [gold]Light[/gold]. If you have no Light, gain 1 Light.
[gold]Claíomh Solais[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (costs 0 from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SOLAIS_SHADED_LIGHT.title: Shade the Light
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SOLAIS_SHADED_LIGHT.descr:
Draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
At the end of this turn, your [gold]Light[/gold] does not fade even if [gold]Claíomh Solais[/gold] is not your current sword (it does not charge either).
[gold]Claíomh Solais[/gold] level {SwordLevel}.
